description: When an agent emits a bare story id in <task-status> (or <completed>) that is the prefix-stripped form of this iteration's claimed task, rewrite to the full claimed DB id before dispatch so short tags complete instead of leaving claims stuck in_progress → stale recovery → re-pick until max iterations.

criteria: Rust: No warnings in `cargo check` output
Rust: No warnings in `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`
Rust: Scoped tests for touched modules pass
No unwrap() in production code paths
No breaking changes to existing APIs unless explicitly required
Sequential and wave both benefit via process_iteration_output only (no path-specific fork)
globalAcceptanceCriteria.description: These criteria apply to ALL implementation tasks

priorityPhilosophy.description: Hierarchy of what matters most when implementing tasks
hierarchy: 1. PLAN — Anticipate edge cases before coding
2. PHASE 2 FOUNDATION — ~1 day now to save ~2+ weeks later (1:10+ ratio); we are pre-launch, foundations compound
3. FUNCTIONING CODE — Pragmatic, reliable, wired in per plan
4. CORRECTNESS — Compiles, type-checks, scoped tests pass deterministically
5. CODE QUALITY — Clean code, qualityDimensions satisfied, no warnings
principles: Quality dimensions explicit — qualityDimensions on every task tells you what 'good' looks like
Phase 2 foundation — prefer solutions that lay strong post-launch foundations (1:10+ savings ratio)
Edge cases = test cases — every known edge case must have a corresponding test
Scoped per-iteration tests, full suite at REVIEW-001 — REVIEW must leave the trunk green including pre-existing failures
Ship working code with tests to prove it; handle Option/Result explicitly; avoid unwrap() in production
Claim-scoped rewrite only — never global short-id lookup against the tasks table

prohibitedOutcomes: Global short-id resolution against the whole tasks table (ambiguous across PRDs)
Unrestricted ends_with / substring match that lets '001' match '…-REFACTOR-001'
Changing TaskLifecycle exact-id lookup as the fix (lifecycle stays exact-id SSoT)
Rewriting only inside extract_status_updates (no claim context; keep parse pure)
Rewriting peer bare ids to the claimed task when they are not the claim's bare form
Altering the dispatch-failed warning byte format for true misses (lifecycle_stderr_contract)
Using a single global status_updates_applied>0 gate instead of per-claimed (id, Done, true) — Learning 2238
Tests that only assert no crash without verifying DB status and outcome flip
Manual edits to tasks/*.json for status (use task-mgr CLI / task-status tags)
Error messages that don't identify what went wrong
Catch-all error handlers that swallow context

userStories.description:
Add pure helpers next to `strip_task_prefix` that decide whether a tag id names this iteration's claimed task (full id or bare/prefix-stripped form) and resolve to the full claimed id.

DO:
1. In `src/loop_engine/output_parsing.rs`, add:
   - `tag_id_refers_to_claimed(tag_id, claimed_id, task_prefix) -> bool`
   - `resolve_tag_id_to_claimed(tag_id, claimed_id, task_prefix) -> &str` (or Cow) returning `claimed_id` when matched, else `tag_id`
2. Match rules (in order):
   a) `tag_id == claimed_id` → match (identity)
   b) `strip_task_prefix(claimed_id, task_prefix)` is a real strip (`bare != claimed_id`) and `tag_id == bare` → match
   c) Fallback: if claimed has standard 8-lowercase-hex PRD prefix (`[0-9a-f]{8}-…`), body after that prefix equals `tag_id` → match (handles missing/wrong `task_prefix`)
3. Unit tests for all table rows in edgeCases.

DO NOT:
- Use unrestricted `ends_with` (Known-bad: `001` matching `97be64d7-REFACTOR-001`)
- Look up ids in the DB
- Import `detection::TaskStatusUpdate` into output_parsing (keep pure string helpers; pipeline owns the rewrite loop)
- Change `extract_status_updates` or lifecycle apply

Known-bad to guard against:
- Suffix-only matching without dash+body equality
- Treating any substring of claimed as a match
edgeCases: Full id already: identity, no rewrite needed
Bare id with correct task_prefix: rewrite to claim
Bare id with task_prefix None but 8-hex claim: rewrite via hex fallback
Bare id with non-hex custom prefix and prefix None: no rewrite

failureModes.expectedBehavior: Unit test for tag '001' fails the PR until match is tightened
Unit test with prefix None + hex claim fails

userStories.notes: Reuse strip_task_prefix in the same module. Mirror the 8-hex rule from model::strip_prd_prefix (private) as a small private helper in output_parsing — do not couple to model.rs. Learning [4959]: dash-boundary / token-aware prefix matching — never bare substring. Learning [4965]: production ids are deterministic 8-hex PRD prefixes. Learning [193]/[4495]: substring false positives are a recurring class — negative tests required.
qualityDimensions: Match logic is pure, deterministic, and side-effect free
No false positives on short numeric suffixes
Helpers are independently unit-testable without DB or pipeline
Docs on the fn explain claim-scoped intent in one sentence

acceptanceCriteria: Positive: process_iteration_output with claimed aaaaaaaa-REFACTOR-001 + <task-status>REFACTOR-001:done</task-status> + task_prefix Some(aaaaaaaa) marks DB done and flips outcome to Completed
Positive: status_results / completed_task_ids use the FULL claimed id after rewrite
Positive: short <completed> bare id for claim also marks done (Step 4b)
Positive: short :failed (or :blocked) for claim applies to full id (not only done)
Negative: bare OTHER-001:done with same claim does NOT mark claim done and status_updates_applied stays 0 for that tag

userStories.description:
In `process_iteration_output`, rewrite short-form ids that refer to the claimed task before lifecycle dispatch and before `<completed>` mark_task_done, so the production failure chain (dispatch miss → stuck in_progress → stale recovery → re-pick) stops for claim-matching bare tags.

DO:
1. Step 3: after `extract_status_updates`, if `task_id` is Some(claimed), for each update if `tag_id_refers_to_claimed(&u.task_id, claimed, task_prefix)` and tag != claimed, set `u.task_id = claimed.to_string()` and emit one operator note via `ui::emit`:
   `Note: resolved short task-status id {bare} → {full} (claimed this iteration)`
2. Apply rewrite for ALL status keywords (done/failed/skipped/irrelevant/unblock/reset), not only done.
3. Step 4b: before `mark_task_done`, rewrite bare `<completed>` ids that refer to claimed the same way (optional note can reuse the same wording with 'completed' instead of 'task-status').
4. Update module docs Step 3 bullet: one sentence on claim-scoped short-id rewrite.
5. Integration tests in `tests/iteration_pipeline.rs`:
   - Happy path: claim `aaaaaaaa-REFACTOR-001`, prefix Some('aaaaaaaa'), tag REFACTOR-001:done → DB done, status_updates_applied==1, outcome Completed, completed_task_ids has full id
   - Non-match: tag OTHER-001:done → not done, status_updates_applied==0
   - Full id regression still completes
   - Short failed (or blocked) status rewrites and applies for claim
   - Short `<completed>REFACTOR-001</completed>` completes claim

DO NOT:
- Pass claimed into apply_status_updates / TaskLifecycle (rewrite stays loop-side)
- Rewrite peer bare ids that do not match this claim's bare form
- Change dispatch-failed warning format for true TaskNotFound
- Fork sequential vs wave — only touch process_iteration_output

modifiesBehavior: true — bare claim-matching tags now complete instead of TaskNotFound.

Known-bad: rewriting then checking only global status_updates_applied would reintroduce Learning 2238 peer false complete.

userStories.notes: Depends on FEAT-001 helpers. Call sites of process_iteration_output: sequential orchestrator + wave process_slot_result — both already pass full claimed task_id and task_prefix. Learning [2238]: claimed-task per-entry gate. Learning [2284]/[2635]/[3334]: per-update success tuples / partial failure tolerance. Learning [2065]/[2086]: shared pipeline is the only wire point for seq+wave parity. Learning [2188]: peer completions stay independent — do not map peer bare ids to claim. Learning [1571]/[1578]/[4054]: side-band tag contract. Learning [3461]: auto-claim todo→done on LoopStatusTag still works when rewrite supplies full id. Learning [2270]: complete is idempotent — dual short+full tags ok. Data contract: ProcessingParams.task_id = Option<&str> full DB id; TaskStatusUpdate.task_id rewritten in-place before apply_status_updates; apply returns Vec<(String, TaskStatusChange, bool)> with rewritten ids.
